title: Open a repository
summary: Open a jj repo with Cmd+O, the Dock menu, or the jayjay CLI launcher.

title: Navigate history
summary: Move through the DAG, use revset chips, and drag changes or bookmarks when you need to rewrite.

title: Review changed files
summary: Review a change file by file, use rich previews for supported formats, mark files reviewed with Space, and hide completed files.

title: Leave review notes
summary: Attach notes to changed lines of the working copy, then read and resolve them from the jayjay CLI.
menuPath: Diff Gutter Context Menu > Add Review Note

title: Compare two changes
summary: Shift-click two revisions to open an interdiff or use bookmark diff for PR-style review.

title: Split work from a change
summary: Use diff edit mode to select files, hunks, or line ranges and extract them into another change.

title: Operate on changes
summary: Describe, commit, squash, abandon, duplicate, merge, absorb, back out, or undo changes.

title: Manage bookmarks and pull requests
summary: Use Bookmark Manager, bookmark chip actions, and forge links for GitHub, GitLab, or Codeberg PRs.

title: Create stacked pull requests
summary: Right-click the tip of a linear stack to create or update one PR or MR per change.
menuPath: Change Context Menu > Create / Update Stacked PRs

title: Resolve conflicts
summary: Use inline Use Ours / Use Theirs when available, or open your configured merge editor.

title: Inspect file history and evolog
summary: Open annotate, file history, or change evolution to understand where code and rewritten changes came from.

title: Use the command palette
summary: Search actions with Cmd+Shift+P, type help for feature help, or run raw jj commands with jj or !.

title: Configure tools and settings
summary: Set appearance, diff behavior, external editor, terminal, jj config, fonts, and AI providers.
